context: Friends discuss a near-accident from yesterday
purpose: Teach: 昨夜/皮膚/棒/手前/即/文法/留学生/毒

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 聞いてよ、昨夜マジで死ぬかと思った。
lines.en: Listen, last night I seriously thought I was going to die.
lines.style: Casual male university student, urgent and slightly shaken, leaning forward.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: え、何があったの？大丈夫？
lines.en: Huh, what happened? Are you okay?
lines.style: Teenage boy, concerned but curious, raising his voice a bit.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 自転車で坂下りてたら、目の前に金属の棒が落ちててさ。
lines.en: I was going down a hill on my bike, and a metal rod was lying right in front of me.
lines.style: Casual male university student, vividly recounting, gesturing with both hands.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うわ、それで？ぶつかったの？
lines.en: Whoa, and then? Did you crash into it?
lines.style: Teenage boy, wide-eyed, leaning in for the next part.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ギリギリ手前で止まれたけど、転んで皮膚がベロッと剥けた。
lines.en: I barely stopped just before it, but I fell and totally scraped my skin.
lines.style: Casual male university student, wincing as he recalls the pain.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うえ、痛そう。錆びてたら毒みたいなもんだよ、ちゃんと消毒した？
lines.en: Ugh, sounds painful. If it was rusty, that's basically like poison — did you disinfect it properly?
lines.style: Teenage boy, grimacing then switching to a lecturing older-brother tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: うん、即病院行った。隣に座ってた留学生が英語で励ましてくれて、こっちは文法ぐちゃぐちゃで返事したよ。
lines.en: Yeah, I went to the hospital immediately. An exchange student sitting next to me cheered me up in English, and I replied with totally broken grammar.
lines.style: Casual male university student, laughing weakly at his own embarrassment.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うける、災難だったね。今日はおとなしく休みなよ。
lines.en: That's hilarious — what a rough day. Just take it easy and rest today.
lines.style: Teenage boy, half-laughing half-sympathetic, patting his friend's shoulder gently.
